faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About POS & Hardware
faq.description: Common questions regarding setup, hardware integration, and store operations

items.q: Can I use the POS offline without internet?
items.a: Yes! If internet drops temporarily, the POS continues issuing bills and printing cash receipts. Once reconnected, all offline orders and stock sync to cloud automatically.

items.q: Do I have to purchase proprietary POS hardware from Sitepow?
items.a: Not at all! Use your existing hardware—Windows PC, Mac, iPad, Android tablet, or smartphone—along with standard market receipt printers and scanners.

items.q: Which thermal receipt printer models are compatible?
items.a: Any printer utilizing the universal ESC/POS standard (both 58mm and 80mm), including Epson, Xprinter, Rongta, Sunmi, and Star Micronics over USB, Wi-Fi, LAN, or Bluetooth.

items.q: Does POS inventory sync instantly with the online store?
items.a: Yes! Every POS transaction deducts stock in real time, so online customers always see accurate available inventory, preventing overselling 100%.

items.q: How many cashier terminals and branches can I run?
items.a: Depending on your plan, you can set up unlimited cashier registers and distinct branch warehouses with per-staff access permissions.

items.q: How do I configure the cash drawer to pop open automatically?
items.a: Simply connect the drawer RJ11 cable to the back of your thermal printer. When cash checkout is confirmed, the printer triggers the drawer kick automatically.
